long_biography.plain_text:
Helping build Orinda's public library took steel businessman Dave Olson beyond his commercial construction work. With his wife, Lynn, he contributed to the project and helped lead its fundraising campaign. The couple also supported the establishment of the Orinda Film Festival, while Olson served on vocational education and ironworker apprenticeship bodies.

His interests extended into technology and preservation. He was an early investor and board member of Cyra Technologies, which developed laser scanning equipment and software. At the Kacyra Family Foundation, he joined the board in 2002 and served as treasurer and on its Heritage Committee.
